<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
  <title>Vibe2 Territory War 20260916</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
  <script src="scripts.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <main id="game"></main>
  <script>
    // Game initialization
    const game = {
      territory: {
        occupied: [],
        expanding: false,
        currentExpansion: null,
        expansionProgress: 0
      },
      ai: {
        enemies: [],
        currentEnemy: null,
        enemyProgress: 0
      },
      ui: {
        status: "idle",
        feedback: "",
        gameStatus: "start"
      },
      economy: {
        resources: 0,
        currency: 0
      },
      progression: {
        currentStep: 0,
        totalSteps: 100
      },
      save: {
        state: {
          territory: [],
          economy: 0,
          progression: 0
        },
        lastSaveTime: new Date()
      }
    };

    // Game logic
    function initGame() {
      // Initialize game state
      game.territory.occupied = [];
      game.ai.enemies = [];
      game.ui.status = "idle";
      game.ui.feedback = "";
      game.economy.resources = 0;
      game.economy.currency = 0;
      game.progression.currentStep = 0;
      game.progression.totalSteps = 100;
      game.save.state = {
        territory: [],
        economy: 0,
        progression: 0
      };
      game.save.lastSaveTime = new Date();
    }

    // Game loop
    function gameLoop() {
      // Update game state
      updateGame();
      // Render game
      renderGame();
      // Check for game over
      if (game.progression.currentStep >= game.progression.totalSteps) {
        endGame();
      }
    }

    // Update game state
    function updateGame() {
      // Update territory expansion
      if (game.territory.expanding) {
        game.territory.currentExpansion = incrementExpansion();
        game.territory.expansionProgress = incrementProgression();
      }

      // Update AI behavior
      if (game.ai.currentEnemy) {
        game.ai.enemyProgress = incrementAIProgression();
      }
    }

    // Render game
    function renderGame() {
      // Render territory map
      renderTerritoryMap();
      // Render UI feedback
      renderUIFeedback();
      // Render game status
      renderGameStatus();
    }

    // End game
    function endGame() {
      // End game logic
      game.ui.status = "end";
      game.ui.feedback = "Game over!";
    }

    // Initialize game
    initGame();
    gameLoop();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
